vocab.example: May I ask who the budget holder is for this kind of purchase?
vocab.example_vi: Cho tôi hỏi ai là người nắm ngân sách cho loại mua sắm này?

vocab.example: I ask open questions first, so the customer can explain freely.

listening.title: Understanding what the customer really needs

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Consultant)
lines.text: Thank you for your time, Mr. Nam. Could you describe your current process for stock reports?

lines.speaker: Nam (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Our staff export data from two systems and then combine everything in Excel.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Consultant)
lines.text: That sounds slow. How long does one full report usually take your team?

lines.speaker: Nam (Operations Manager)
lines.text: About two days each month, and small mistakes happen quite often.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Consultant)
lines.text: So your current challenge is manual work and small errors. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: Nam (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Exactly. Accurate numbers are a must-have, and after that, faster reporting.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Consultant)
lines.text: May I dig deeper? How many people would use the new system every day?

lines.speaker: Nam (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Around fifteen people in the warehouse, plus three staff in the office.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Consultant)
lines.text: Understood. Do you have a spending limit in mind for this year?

lines.speaker: Nam (Operations Manager)
lines.text: We have some money set aside, but our director is the budget holder.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Sales Consultant)
lines.text: Thank you. I will list every requirement and send a short summary tomorrow.
